packages.title: Boombox in Drive
packages.summary: Keeps the Boombox and Megaphone buttons usable while driving: neutralises the 4 isCarParked checks in ExternalSpeakerSettings::updateButtonStates that re-grey them on every gear change. Pairs with the built-in enable-boombox package.

packages.title: Fart & Furious
packages.summary: Bringing emissions back to EVs. Re-enables vehicle emissions by routing the in-cabin fart sound effect through Drive instead of Park, restoring a more authentic ICE-era atmosphere.

packages.title: Horn in Drive
packages.summary: Makes the Boombox Horn Sound and Replace Horn toggles work in Drive like in Park, so your horn sound plays when you honk in gear, and can keep Horn Sound on across UI restarts. Also shows Replace Horn outside the US, Canada and Mexico. Replace Horn silences the real horn.

manifest.title: Horn in Drive

settings.title: Keep horn toggles on after a UI restart
settings.summary: Stock firmware turns Horn Sound and Replace Horn off whenever the touchscreen restarts (e.g. after a CoilShift install) or the car crosses a saved location. On keeps them as you set them. Replace Horn still resets on a restart: the car never saves it.

Horn Sound switch stays interactive (externalSpeakerStateChanged -> customPedestrianWarningSoundAllowed); feeds enableSwitch(true)
Drive no longer clears Replace Horn (onShiftStateChanged skips setValue(false))
Replace Horn switch shown outside US/CA/MX (ExternalSpeakerSettings ctor -> canSuppressHorn, a VAPI_countryCode check); optional so a moved gate never costs the other five

keep_toggles: UI start and geofence crossings no longer clear Replace Horn (updateFactoryLowHornNoiseAreaMode's non-factory branch calls DataValueManager::instance() instead of setValue(GUI_disableHorn, false)); false leaves the call stock
keep_toggles: the same for Horn Sound (setValue(GUI_pesHornSoundEnabled, false))

packages.title: Random lock chime
packages.summary: Plays a random clip every time you lock. Add a folder named LockChime to your USB stick (any partition the car mounts) and fill it with short WAV clips: mono, 48 kHz, 16-bit. Needs a USB lock sound set in Toybox > Boombox > Lock Sound. Removing it restores your sound.

manifest.title: Random lock chime
manifest.summary: Plays a random clip every time you lock. Add a folder named LockChime to your USB stick (any partition the car mounts) and fill it with short WAV clips: mono, 48 kHz, 16-bit. Needs a USB lock sound set in Toybox > Boombox > Lock Sound. Removing it restores your sound.

settings.title: USB folder name
settings.summary: Name of the folder holding your clips, on any partition of the USB stick the car mounts. Clips must be WAV, mono, 48 kHz, 16-bit (others are skipped), ideally under 5 seconds. To convert: ffmpeg -i in.mp3 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le -t 5 out.wav

packages.title: Netflix fix - OLD FIRMWARE ONLY (browser too old)
packages.summary: ONLY FOR OLD FIRMWARE WHERE THE BROWSER IS TOO OLD: Netflix shows 'browser too old' (E109), e.g. 2026.8.6 with Widevine 4.10.2934. Binds Widevine CDM 4.10.3050 into the Netflix sandbox and sets a clean Chrome UA. Does nothing on firmware that already has it.
